title: This works every time
body:
I just cannot explain. This is great I constantly use this when I get extra busy and it works every time. You can use it as a widget and if you’re forgetting something, it’s just on the widget to be like ‘hey you need to do this now’ and like telling you that you have something to do. I share this with my besty when  we have homework or a group assignment and it always helps. One thing to say is that we should be allowed to comment in the shared reminders. Overall, this app is great and you can customise your reminders icon with emojis and stickers so everyone can have a unique one.

title: 很好用的app
body: 长久以来一直认为提醒事项是垃圾app，因为需要记事用备忘录，需要提醒用日历，这个app就是多余的存在。后来发现当你生活中需要有多件事情需要处理，旅行前多件物品需要准备、或者近期有多件商品需要购买时，就会发现它的香了。每个事件都可以单独设定提醒日期或时间，设置地点、添加备忘等。所有事件自动根据时间或者手动排序，处理完成的事件事件打勾确认默认排序到最尾或隐藏。而且还可以分类不同类型的事项，非常方便可靠。现在日历用的少了，基本都用提醒事项来记事了。
